subject.title: fix(reef): bound inbox websocket open waits at 30s

question: Is a fixed internal 30-second WebSocket-upgrade deadline the supported Reef relay tolerance for production connections?
rationale: Tests establish timer correctness but cannot determine the slowest legitimate relay, proxy, or TLS environment the bundled channel intends to support.

options.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
options.body: Land the refreshed patch with the fixed internal bound and treat slower upgrades as failed attempts that should reconnect.

options.title: Retune the internal deadline
options.body: Choose an owner-supported fixed value and update the focused lifecycle proof without adding a new user configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Land the refreshed patch with the fixed internal bound and treat slower upgrades as failed attempts that should reconnect.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a bundled-channel production availability policy rather than an automated mechanical repair.
